rationale: For each bus, computed voltage deficit from target (0.98 pu), divided by voltage sensitivity to get required reactive power, then clipped by aggregate EV inverter capability (sqrt(S² - P²) per unit). Bus 2 requires 22.5 kvar (within 25.36 kvar capability), bus 3 requires 13.86 kvar (limited by 13.86 kvar capability). Corrected voltages reach target or approach it within capability constraints.
